scripts.dev: npm run db:generate && npm -w @gool/database run build && npm -w @gool/contracts run build && concurrently -n api,miniapp -c auto "npm -w @gool/api run dev" "npm -w @gool/miniapp run dev"
scripts.dev:api: npm run db:generate && npm -w @gool/database run build && npm -w @gool/contracts run build && npm -w @gool/api run dev
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm -w @gool/database run build && npm -w @gool/contracts run build && npm -w @gool/api run build && npm -w @gool/miniapp run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm -w @gool/database run build && npm -w @gool/contracts run build && npm -w @gool/api run typecheck && npm -w @gool/miniapp run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run architecture:check && npm run db:validate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run format:check && npm run build
